turns.user_utterance: I checked my account today and it said I was out of money. How do I transfer money into my account?
turns.assistant_response: To transfer money into your account, do you mean a bank transfer (send money from your bank) or topping up with a card? Also, are you trying to add money right now because your balance shows “out of money”?

turns.user_utterance: I’d like to move money from my bank account into this one.
turns.assistant_response:
Sure—if you want to move money from your bank into this account, that’s a bank transfer to your Revolut account.

In the app, go to **Top up / Add money** → **Bank transfer** (or **Transfer money**), then copy your **local transfer details** (account/routing/IBAN). Send the transfer from your bank using those details. 

Do you want to transfer in via **local transfer** (IBAN/account number) or **international transfer** (SWIFT/IBAN)?
